solverLine: What the notes measure. Each margin note reads the cross-section under the front face, averaged over 120 m of valley and rounded to 10 m, so the numbers do not jump from one grid cell to the next. The registered protocol measures single sections (Protocol). The front face opens on a section chosen for display after the runs were scanned; the lesson's claims rest on the registered under-ice section instead (Lesson). Grid 160 cells by 64 cells, each 40 m across. Solver: webgpu.
